summary: Biddance AI Systems, Inc. (formerly Hitek Global Inc.) filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of its continuation from the Cayman Islands to the British Virgin Islands and a name change to Biddance AI Systems, Inc., effective August 24, 2026. Shareholders approved both at the July 29, 2026 AGM. The filing includes new BVI memorandum and articles of association. This is a routine corporate domicile and name change, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, premiums, or financial restructuring are involved. The filing also incorporates the 6-K into existing F-3 registration statements. Watch for potential future strategic actions under the new BVI structure.
